name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 7 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-07-04, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
